specs.title: clicking the logo on the wishlist page plays the animation, then returns to the home screen
the shop header is the same height as the home screen header
theme toggle switches between light and dark mode and remembers the choice
cart shows a product photo per line and supports increasing/decreasing the quantity
the "+" button is disabled once the cart quantity reaches the available stock
user can open the dedicated favorites page from the home screen
user can remove a product from favorites directly on the wishlist page
typing a query shows a matching result with its name, price and category
search tolerates a typo in the product name
search also matches the category, not just the product name
search also matches the product description
a query that matches nothing shows the "no results" message
clicking a result opens the product detail view for the right product
pressing Enter with a single result opens it, same as clicking
the clear button empties the field and closes the results
